info.description:
Preview service.

You can preview the following type of files:

* **images (png/jpeg/gif/svg)**
* **pdf**
* **documents (xls, xlsx, ods, ppt, pptx, odp, doc, docx, odt)**
* **video (mp4, mkv, …) — thumbnail/preview of first frame**

You will be able to:

* **Preview images**.
* **Generate smart thumbnails**.

The main difference between thumbnail and preview functionality is that
preview tends to be more faithful while thumbnail tends to elaborate on it,
cropping it by default and rounding the image if asked.
Preview should always output the file in its original format, while thumbnail
will convert it to an image.
There is no difference in quality between png and jpeg; the difference in
quality can be achieved only by asking for a jpeg format and changing the
quality parameter.
Asking for a GIF output can only be done when the input file is a GIF,
otherwise it will raise an error.

post.description:
Create and returns a pdf preview of the given file;
the pdf file will contain the first and last page given.
With default values will return all the pages.
- **file**: file uploaded with FormData
- **first_page**: integer value of first page to preview (n>=1)
- **last_page**: integer value of last page to preview (0 = last of the pdf)
- **lang_tag**: language tag for document conversion (default en-US)

400.description: Some values in the query were not correct.

404.description: Requested item was not found in the storage.

503.description: PDF rendering temporarily unavailable (pool exhaustion or worker start failure).

post.description:
Create and returns the thumbnail of the given file;
the image rendered will be the first page.
- **quality**: quality of the output image
- **output_format**: format of the output image
- **area**: width x height (e.g. 100x200)
- **shape**: Rounded and Rectangular are currently supported
- **lang_tag**: language tag for document conversion (default en-US)
- **file**: file uploaded with FormData

200.description: Successful Response — binary image data (rasterized first page)

get.description:
Extracts the first frame from a video file fetched by id and version,
then returns a scaled/cropped image of that frame.
- **id**: UUID of the video file
- **version**: version of the video file
- **area**: width x height (e.g. 100x200)
- **crop**: True will crop the image starting from the borders
- **quality**: quality of the output image
- **output_format**: format of the output image
- **service_type**: Service that owns the resource

200.description: Successful Response — binary image data (first video frame)

400.description: Some values in the query were not correct or video format is unsupported.

404.description: Requested item was not found in the storage.

422.description: Validation Error or video too large.

get.description:
Extracts the first frame from a video file fetched by id and version,
then returns a cropped thumbnail image.
- **id**: UUID of the video file
- **version**: version of the video file
- **area**: width x height (e.g. 100x200)
- **shape**: Rounded and Rectangular are currently supported
- **quality**: quality of the output image
- **output_format**: format of the output image
- **service_type**: Service that owns the resource

200.description: Successful Response — binary image data (first video frame, cropped)

400.description: Some values in the query were not correct or video format is unsupported.

404.description: Requested item was not found in the storage.

422.description: Validation Error or video too large.
